headline: Congo's Ebola outbreak reaches 5,000 cases as it outpaces response efforts
context: Government data showed the outbreak had so far recorded 5,021 cases, including 2,378 deaths. The outbreak has infected and killed more people at a greater speed than any other outbreak in history.
